overview: Momentum Terminal backend with short position infrastructure: stable per-user positions, long/short mark-to-market, allocation and redemption, spread widening, and a velocity circuit breaker.
features: Stable per-user position storage keyed by principal and asset
Short allocation and redemption with $500 cap
LMSR spread widening on short entry when score rises
Velocity circuit breaker blocking rapid short entries
Public getters for short position state
